text: Woori Bank became a wholly owned subsidiary of Woori Financial Group on 11 January 2019, through a comprehensive stock transfer under the Korean Commercial Code that relaunched Woori as a financial holding company.
short: Woori Bank is a wholly owned subsidiary of Woori Financial Group.
text: Woori Bank became a wholly owned subsidiary of Woori Financial Group in the January 2019 comprehensive stock transfer; the holding company then comprised Woori Bank, Woori FIS, Woori Private Equity Asset Management, Woori Credit, Woori Finance Research Institute and Woori Fund Services.
